g.text: One source patch selects one complete encoder → entropy → decoder chain
Independent weights and latents at every depth.
Schematic only. Source-aware routing occurs at the encoder; the decoder reads the transmitted model ID. End-to-end time must include routing, entropy, transfers and assembly.
